name: Lord Oberon
source:
Lord Oberon is the ruler over the fairy settlement of Liebwald. He is married to Lady Titania and lives at the royal residence.
[spoiler]He is shown to be the protector of the fairy territory, using a spear to fight off opponents when necessary, though it appears that he takes little pride in the process. [/spoiler]
